items.source: When parsed patterns are enabled a parsed RequestPath is expected to have been parsed externally by the DispatcherServlet or ServletRequestPathFilter.
items.translation: 当解析模式已启用时，预期RequestPath 已由 DispatcherServlet 或 ServletRequestPathFilter 通过 解析。

items.source: By default, the supported interceptor types are HandlerInterceptor and WebRequestInterceptor. Each given WebRequestInterceptor is wrapped with WebRequestHandlerInterceptorAdapter.
items.translation: 默认情况下，支持的拦截器类型为 HandlerInterceptor 和 WebRequestInterceptor。每个给定的 WebRequestInterceptor 都会用 WebRequestHandlerInterceptorAdapter 进行包装。

items.source: Supported interceptor types are HandlerInterceptor, WebRequestInterceptor, and MappedInterceptor. Mapped interceptors apply only to request URLs that match its path patterns. Mapped interceptor beans are also detected by type during initialization.
items.translation: 支持的拦截器类型包括 HandlerInterceptor、WebRequestInterceptor 以及 MappedInterceptor。 映射拦截器仅适用于匹配其路径模式的请求 URL。 在初始化期间，还会通过类型检测映射拦截器 Bean。

items.source: This is called in addition to any MappedInterceptors that may have been provided via setInterceptors(Object...), by default adding all beans of type MappedInterceptor from the current context and its ancestors. Subclasses can override and refine this policy.
items.translation: 这会在通过setInterceptors(Object...)提供的任何MappedInterceptor之外被调用，默认情况下会从当前上下文及其祖先上下文中添加所有类型为MappedInterceptor的 Bean。子类可以重写并细化此策略。

items.source: By default, as of 6.0, this is set to a PathPatternParser instance with default settings and therefore use of parsed patterns is enabled. Set this to null to switch to String path matching via AntPathMatcher instead.
items.translation: 默认情况下，从 6.0 版本开始，此值设置为具有默认设置的PathPatternParser实例，因此启用了解析模式的使用。将其设置为null以改用通过AntPathMatcher进行字符串路径匹配。

items.source: NOTE: The passed-in handler object may be a raw handler or a pre-built HandlerExecutionChain. This method should handle those two cases explicitly, either building a new HandlerExecutionChain or extending the existing chain.
items.translation: 注意：传入的处理程序对象可能是原始处理程序或预构建的HandlerExecutionChain。此方法应显式处理这两种情况，即构建一个新的HandlerExecutionChain或扩展现有的链。

items.source: Will be invoked before initInterceptors() adapts the specified interceptors into HandlerInterceptor instances.
items.translation: 将在 `initInterceptors()` 将指定的拦截器适配为 `HandlerInterceptor` 实例之前被调用。

items.source: The default implementation builds a standard HandlerExecutionChain with the given handler, the common interceptors of the handler mapping, and any MappedInterceptors matching to the current request URL. Interceptors are added in the order they were registered. Subclasses may override this in order to extend/rearrange the list of interceptors.
items.translation: 默认实现会构建一个标准的 HandlerExecutionChain，其中包含给定的处理器、处理器映射的通用拦截器以及任何匹配当前请求 URL 的 MappedInterceptors。拦截器按照注册顺序添加。子类可以重写此方法以扩展或重新排列拦截器列表。

items.source: Note: This base class does not support exposure of the HandlerMapping.PATH_WITHIN_HANDLER_MAPPING_ATTRIBUTE. Support for this attribute is up to concrete subclasses, typically based on request URL mappings.
items.translation: 注意：此基类不支持暴露 HandlerMapping.PATH_WITHIN_HANDLER_MAPPING_ATTRIBUTE。对此属性的支持由具体子类决定，通常基于请求 URL 映射。

items.source: Otherwise for String pattern matching via PathMatcher the path is resolved by this method.
items.translation: 否则，对于通过 `PathMatcher` 进行的 `String` 模式匹配，该路径将由此方法resolved。

items.source: For simply adding an interceptor in a custom subclass, consider calling super.getHandlerExecutionChain(handler, request) and invoking HandlerExecutionChain.addInterceptor(HandlerInterceptor) on the returned chain object.
items.translation: 对于在自定义子类中简单添加拦截器，请调用super.getHandlerExecutionChain(handler, request)，并在返回的链对象上调用HandlerExecutionChain.addInterceptor(HandlerInterceptor)。

items.source: Note: This property is mutually exclusive with the below properties, all of which are not necessary for parsed patterns and are ignored when a PathPatternParser is available:
items.translation: 注意： 此属性与以下属性互斥，且这些属性对于解析模式均非必需；当存在 PathPatternParser 时，它们将被忽略：

items.source: By default, this is AntPathMatcher.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是AntPathMatcher。

items.translation: 这与 setCorsConfigurationSource(CorsConfigurationSource) 互斥。

items.source: This is mutually exclusive with setCorsConfigurations(Map).
items.translation: 这与setCorsConfigurations(Map)互斥。

items.source: By default DefaultCorsProcessor is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用DefaultCorsProcessor。

items.source: On CORS pre-flight requests this method should return a match not for the pre-flight request but for the expected actual request based on the URL path, the HTTP methods from the "Access-Control-Request-Method" header, and the headers from the "Access-Control-Request-Headers" header thus allowing the CORS configuration to be obtained via getCorsConfiguration(Object, HttpServletRequest),
items.translation: 在 CORS 预检请求中，此方法不应针对预检请求返回匹配结果，而应基于 URL 路径、来自"Access-Control-Request-Method"标头的 HTTP 方法以及来自"Access-Control-Request-Headers"标头的标头，针对预期的实际请求返回匹配结果，从而允许通过getCorsConfiguration(Object, HttpServletRequest)获取 CORS 配置。

items.source: Note: This method may also return a pre-built HandlerExecutionChain, combining a handler object with dynamically determined interceptors. Statically specified interceptors will get merged into such an existing chain.
items.translation: 注意：此方法也可能返回一个预构建的 HandlerExecutionChain，它将处理器对象与动态确定的拦截器组合在一起。静态指定的拦截器将合并到此类现有链中。
